purpose: Prove durable context becomes a reviewed Memory Candidate locally, never a silent instruction: two Memory Candidates (CMC-LOCAL-*) from distinct origins (a source-record pattern and a receipt pattern) each carry source refs, rationale, confidence, scope, recall/use policy, receipt history, and actsAsInstruction=false; one candidate is moved to rejected and one to needs_clarification, each transition backed by a manifest-verb receipt with before/after while the candidate stays distinct from evidence and instructions (distinctFromInstruction=true). No live Dataverse mutation occurs; every would-be live write and any later promotion to an Approved Instruction stays receipt-gated to a future story.

candidates.com_name: Memory candidate - manual meeting note yields multiple typed work items
candidates.com_summary: Manual meeting notes captured under the summary_allowed data boundary can carry more than one commitment, so a single Source Record may produce multiple proposed Work Items of distinct types (meeting_action, decision, risk) that must each be reviewed independently rather than collapsed into one task.
candidates.com_rationale: The 2026-07-13 platform sync meeting note (CSR-MANUAL-MEETING-001) produced three distinct proposed Work Items (CWI-LOCAL-MEETING-ACTION-001, CWI-LOCAL-DECISION-002, CWI-LOCAL-RISK-001) of three different types from one summary-allowed capture. That recurrence is durable context worth remembering: reviewers should expect multi-commitment meeting notes and triage each commitment separately instead of assuming one source maps to one task.
candidates.com_recall_use_policy: Surface this candidate at extraction review when a meeting note carries two or more commitments; do not auto-apply it as an instruction. A reviewer must confirm the pattern still holds for the note under review before relying on it.

sourceRecordPattern.patternNote: One summary_allowed manual meeting source produced three proposed Work Items of distinct com_workitemtype values (meeting_action, decision, risk); the pattern was observed from the Story 1.4 extraction evidence, not invented.

candidates.com_name: Memory candidate - drifted Outlook thread is superseded, never edited in place
candidates.com_summary: When an Outlook thread source drifts after capture, the Council supersedes it by creating a new Source Record linked via com_parent_ref and appending a source_drifted receipt, rather than editing the held record or its prior extraction rationale; the prior record and its rationale stay byte-identical.
candidates.com_rationale: The Story 1.5 drift run observed that CSR-OUTLOOK-THREAD-MOCK-001 (a held hash-only mock thread) was superseded by CSR-OUTLOOK-THREAD-MOCK-002 via com_parent_ref, backed by receipt CR-LOCAL-SUPERSEDE-001 (verb source_drifted, before held, after superseded), while CR-LOCAL-DRIFT-001 recorded new version evidence for CSR-MANUAL-MEETING-001 without rewriting its capture. The durable lesson is that drift never rewrites prior rationale or receipts; supersession is the sanctioned path.
candidates.com_recall_use_policy: Surface this candidate whenever a captured source is observed to have a newer version; do not auto-execute supersession. A reviewer must confirm the source kind, the data boundary policy, and that a superseding record is appropriate before relying on the pattern.

receiptPatternOrigin.patternNote: The source_drifted receipt pattern (CR-LOCAL-DRIFT-001 records new version evidence; CR-LOCAL-SUPERSEDE-001 moves the held thread to superseded via a com_parent_ref superseding record) was observed from the Story 1.5 slice, not invented.

receipts.com_decision_rationale: A multi-commitment manual meeting note pattern was observed in Story 1.4 extraction evidence; a Memory Candidate is proposed (not promoted) so a reviewer can accept, reject, or ask for clarification before it ever acts as instruction.

A source_drifted receipt pattern was observed in Story 1.5 evidence; a Memory Candidate is proposed (not promoted) capturing that drift supersedes rather than edits in place, so a reviewer can accept, reject, or ask for clarification before it ever acts as instruction.

Review rejected this candidate: the multi-commitment meeting-note pattern is sample-derived and not yet tenant-verified, and a reviewer judged that promoting it would risk biasing extraction toward over-proposing work from a single note. The candidate remains distinct from evidence and instructions; no Approved Instruction is created.

Review moved this candidate to needs_clarification: the supersession lesson is sound but the candidate must clarify which source kinds and data boundary policies it applies to (hash_only threads only, or all drifted sources) before it could be approved. The candidate remains distinct from evidence and instructions; no Approved Instruction is created.
